bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root" || exit 80
flags=0
test -f "$root/artifacts/bot/src/bot/bugReportHandlers.ts" && flags=$((flags+1)) || true
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" && flags=$((flags+2)) || true
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q 'gaybbs' && flags=$((flags+4)) || true
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && flags=$((flags+8)) || true
exit $((100+flags))
